rules.layout: A geometric band or column built from the grid (stripes, chevrons, nested rectangles, outlined blocks) frames a clean content area. Strict symmetry or strict repetition; the pattern is a structure, not a texture.
rules.color: Light ground; the charter colours as flat fills inside thick ink outlines; the accent as a rhythmic repeat. Never more than four colours including ink.
rules.typography: Sturdy geometric sans in capitals for the headline, clear sans for the text. Generous tracking on small labels.
rules.devices: Thick outlines, chevrons, stepped triangles, nested squares, woven stripes, one meaningful symbol used as a mark.
rules.imagery: Crafts, textiles, architecture and portraits in clear daylight; or flat geometric illustration.

image.negative: blurry, folklore cliché, safari, poverty imagery, random pattern, text

bans: No random decorative pattern: geometry follows the grid.
No symbol used without its meaning.
Never text over the pattern.

rules.layout: Monumental geometry on a light sun-bleached ground: one large structural shape (arch, star, sunburst, stepped block) anchors the composition; type set flush to its edge; a strong horizontal base line; asymmetric but stable.

rules.typography: Bold geometric or grotesque capitals for the headline, wide and stable; body in a clear sans. Strong scale contrast, flush left against the shape.
rules.devices: Arches, stepped blocks, sunbursts, star shapes, thick horizontal bands, concrete-like textures in very low contrast.
rules.imagery: Architectural photography in hard sunlight: concrete, shadows, sky; portraits with pride and dignity; never folklore clichés.

rules.layout: Half to two thirds of the canvas left empty, deliberately and not as leftover. ONE occupied zone per composition, snapped to a strict 12-column grid. Generous, equal margins (at least 8% of the shorter side). One focal point, never two.

rules.typography: Two typographic levels only, separated by a ratio of at least 4x. Headline in a medium weight, never black. Slightly open tracking on capitals (0.08–0.2em). Left aligned by default.
rules.devices: A 1px rule, breathing room, optical alignment. No shadow, no decorative radius, no badge, no ornamental icon.

rules.layout: A centred playbill on cream paper: stacked lines of type of very different sizes and widths, each line its own size, separated by fine rules and small ornaments; a decorative frame around the whole. Symmetry is the law.
rules.color: Cream or ivory paper ground (the charter background), ink in the text colour, the primary as a second printing ink on one or two lines, the accent sparingly on an ornament.
rules.typography: A mix of wood-type styles: condensed capitals, wide slab capitals, a fine italic for connecting words. Every line justified to the width of the frame. Small capitals for details.
rules.devices: Fine double rules, corner ornaments, small fleurons, a decorative border, an oval medallion for the image or the date.
rules.imagery: Engraving-style line illustrations or sepia photographs inside an oval or a frame.

bans: No dark ground: the paper is light.
Never more than two inks plus paper.
No modern geometric sans for the headline.

rules.layout: A bold repeated motif fills one zone (a band, a frame, or a full background panel) while the message sits on a clean light panel beside or over it. The pattern is framed, never under the text.
rules.color: The charter colours turned into a saturated motif of two or three colours; the text panel stays light with ink text. Contrast is joyful but the reading zone is calm.
rules.typography: Confident display type, rounded or slab, in large size on the light panel; body in a clear sans. One headline, short.
rules.devices: Repeating motifs built from simple shapes (circles, leaves, concentric rings, crosshatch), framed pattern bands, a clean label panel.
rules.imagery: Portraits and fashion photography with fabric, bright daylight, proud poses; product shots on patterned backdrops.
